Product Description


Each year since the rebirth of the Shinshu distillery in the heart of the Japanese Alps in 2011, Mars whisky has released an expression to showcase the evolution of Komagatake single malt. This release from 2022 was aged in a combination of ex-bourbon, sherry and Port wine casks, creating a silky and nutty whiskey with notes of exotic fruits, mixed nuts and acacia honey.
